blocks.text: A server page can pass simple serialisable values into a Client Component. The client can then use the values for interaction.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not pass an ordinary server function as a client prop. Data crossing the boundary needs an allowed serialisable form.
